title: Automate weekly release cadence, RC promotion, and release-notes generation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Establish a reliable weekly release train with automated cut, RC tagging, and release-notes generation tied to changelog and CI metadata. This ticket consolidates multiple ad-hoc steps into a deterministic pipeline that supports LTS channel tagging and safe rollout gates.

Background: Currently, release cuts are manual: engineers run a script, create RC tags, and handcraft notes from merged PRs. This causes timing variability, missed changelog entries, and inconsistent RC promotion criteria. As we scale Dedicated and Private deployments, we need predictable LTS channels and automated gates to avoid regressions during rollout.

Proposed: Implement a GitHub Actions workflow (or internal CI job) that:
- Runs on a weekly schedule (Mondays 09:00 UTC)
- Compiles merged PRs since last stable tag and generates a draft release (notes) using PR labels and issue references
- Runs release candidate (RC) tests: smoke, canary e2e, and perf sanity (via eks/canary infra)
- If tests pass, automatically create RC tag like vX.Y.Z-rc.N and publish draft notes to Confluence/Drive and GitHub Releases
- Provide a guarded promotion path: automated checks + manual approval gate for LTS channel promotions
- Integrate with Console rollout system by creating rollout plan metadata and experiment flags

Non-goals: Full rollback automation (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Weekly release job runs on schedule and creates draft release in GitHub with correct vX.Y.Z-rc.N format
Draft release notes contain PR titles, authors, changelog labels (fix/feat/ops), and links to associated issues
RC job triggers pre-defined RC test matrix and posts status back to the draft release
Promotion to LTS channel requires an explicit approval step tracked in the release metadata
Upgrade tooling (CLI or Console button) can list available RCs and LTS versions with changelogs
work_items: Draft CI workflow and reusable action for changelog assembly (ENG task)
Implement RC test matrix and integrate perf smoke jobs
Add tagging strategy helper that reads semver and computes rc.N
Wire Confluence/GDrive template for release notes and add webhook to populate it
Add Console UI hook to display pending RCs and add approve/deny button
Add metrics & dashboards: release frequency, RC pass rate, time-to-promote

risks: Flaky e2e tests may delay automatic promotions — mitigated by staging canary and retry policies
Accidental tag collisions if semver computation is incorrect — include safety checks and a dry-run mode
Permissions: CI needs write access to create tags and Confluence entries — coordinate with security for scoped robot account
Customer-facing release notes might leak internal links — sanitize content and use public templates
notes: Related: LTS channel policy draft lives in PM doc (PM-421); ensure semantics align before finalizing tag naming
Consider adding a 'promote-if-no-regressions' automation that can auto-promote to LTS after N stable weeks (separate RFC)
Prefer single source of truth for changelog labels: add lint in PR template to require 'changelog/*' or 'no-changelog'
